text.p: The number of private enterprises in Shanghai rose to 49,212 in August 1996 from 2,288 in 1991, the Wen Hui Bao newspaper said on Thursday.
The private firms, involving in a wide range of industries, provide jobs to 520,000 people, including 85,000 who formerly worked in state companies, the newspaper said.
The private firms paid a total of 775 million yuan in tax in the first eight months and the amount will reach 1.0-1.2 billion yuan in all of 1996, up from 589 million in 1995, it said.
In August, Shanghai's private firms had a total of 28.94 billion yuan in registered assets with an average of 588,000 yuan per firm, it said but gave no more details.
